topics.topic: Definition of flow input "size bound" and how size is measured for scalar vs many-valued inputs
questions: What is the "size bound" for a flow input value, and how is size measured (especially for `many` values): per element, whole array value, or both?

topics.topic: What determines repeated query parameter encoding: declared cardinality, runtime list value shape, or both
questions: For query parameters, is repetition driven by port `cardinality: many`, by JSON value being a list regardless of cardinality, or by both?

topics.topic: Whether an approved requested-approval with stale request_digest still authorizes sending
questions: If the owner approves a `requested` approval whose `request_digest` no longer matches the request now to be sent, must the kernel still send immediately and mark it `used`, or must it treat that approval as non-authority and leave it `approved`/unused?

topics.topic: Whether and how a newly created standing grant unblocks a run already waiting for owner approval
questions: When a node element is already waiting for approval and the owner grants that node for the flow version, does the waiting element proceed under the new grant, and if so on which trigger?

topics.topic: Whether cardinality: many is allowed for path placeholder ports and, if not, at what stage it must be rejected
questions: Must a binding be refused at proposal/accept time when a path placeholder port has `cardinality: many`, or is that allowed and only refused later when a list value is encountered at send time?

topics.topic: Whether idempotency_key syntax must be validated for read-effect operations
questions: When the operation effect class is `read`, must `idempotency_key` syntax still be validated, or skipped entirely?

topics.topic: Whether node outputs are atomic on validation failure of one output versus partially deliverable
questions: If a node has multiple outputs and only one output value fails validation, are other outputs from that same node delivered/stored, or is the node treated atomically with no outputs delivered?

topics.topic: Whether trial-case port "fit" requires an exact full port-set match versus allowing missing/extra mappings
questions: Does "fit" require exactly the full port set (no missing, no extra), or are partial/extra mappings allowed in trial cases and expected outputs?

topics.topic: Which unknown reference to report when multiple provided references are unknown
questions: If one request names several references and more than one is unknown, which unknown reference must be reported as the refusal cause?
